answers: Using standard Salesforce sharing rules and roles
Using permission sets to grant record access based on criteria
Using Apex sharing with custom logic and auditing
Using standard validation rules to control record access
feedbacks: Standard sharing rules do not offer enough complexity.
Permissions do not allow for complex record access control.
Apex sharing is the best method for complex record access requirements.
Validation rules do not control access.
questions.explanation: Apex sharing allows granular control over record access, and custom audit logic can be added in the apex code.

questions.question: A Salesforce organization is using a custom object called 'Product' that is related to multiple other objects through lookup relationships. They need to implement a real-time data synchronization system that keeps the related records up-to-date whenever any changes are made to the 'Product' record. answers: Using Apex triggers with synchronous DML operations
Using Queueable Apex for asynchronous DML operations
Using Platform Events for event-driven data synchronization
Using a scheduled Apex job for periodic data updates

Queueable apex has limitations with large data volumes.
Platform events are designed for real-time data updates.
Scheduled jobs are not suitable for real-time updates.
questions.explanation: Platform Events will give you near real-time synchronization and have good flexibility for decoupled integrations.

questions.question: A Salesforce administrator needs to create a series of reports that show key performance indicators (KPIs) across different business units. Using custom report types with cross-object formulas and summary functions
Using a custom Apex class to retrieve data and generate CSV reports
Using a third party business intelligence tool connected to salesforce via API's

Custom report types provide good flexibility for cross object and complex calculations.
Custom apex is overkill for these simple reporting requirements.
Third party tools are complex to use.
questions.explanation: Custom report types with formulas and groupings provide the easiest way to create complex KPI reports.

questions.question: A Salesforce developer is creating a Lightning Web Component that needs to perform a large number of API calls to an external service. Using a custom JavaScript class to manage API calls with error handling
Using Apex controllers to make the API calls with retry logic
Using client-side javascript to retry the API calls

Custom javascript does not have native support for retries.
Apex controllers can easily implement retry logic.
Javascript based retries are complex to implement.

questions.question: A company is implementing a data integration strategy that involves multiple systems. Using an ETL platform for all data integration tasks
Using Apex callouts for real time integrations
Implementing data validation rules to ensure data accuracy
Implementing a custom logging system to track all data transformations

Mapping document will help maintainability of the integration.
ETL tools are designed to handle complex integration patterns.
Apex calls have limitations.
Validation rules ensure data quality and consistency.
Custom logging will allow for auditing of data transformations.

questions.question: A Salesforce developer is creating a complex Apex trigger on a custom object that has multiple relationships with other objects. Using custom settings to manage trigger execution
Using a custom trigger framework with a static map
Using a trigger guard class to prevent recursion
Using SOQL queries to check if the object already has been updated
Using workflow rules for controlling updates to the record

Custom settings are not scalable.
Static maps are a robust way of preventing recursion.
Trigger guard classes have built in methods to prevent recursion.
Querying the database adds overhead.
Workflow rules cannot prevent recursion of triggers.
questions.explanation: Trigger framework with static maps and trigger guard classes will prevent the trigger from running multiple times and maintain data integrity.

questions.question: A Salesforce organization is implementing a multi-tenant system where each customer has their own custom set of fields, objects, and business processes. Separate Git repositories offer the best way to manage independent deployments.

questions.question: A Salesforce administrator needs to create a report that shows the average time to close opportunities by sales team, grouped by quarter, and also needs to display the results in a visual format that shows the trends across quarters. Using custom report types with summary formulas and dashboards
Using a custom Apex class to retrieve data and generate a CSV, then using a 3rd party tool
Using Salesforce dashboards with multiple report charts

Custom report types provide more control over the data and visualizations.
Custom Apex is not needed for basic reporting.
Dashboards only summarize the data, not show granular details.

questions.question: A Salesforce developer is creating a Lightning Web Component that needs to display a large amount of data in a table. The table should support sorting, filtering, and pagination. Platform events are the best solution for real-time bi-directional synchronization.

questions.question: A Salesforce developer is creating an Apex trigger on a custom object that has a complex set of business rules. questions.question: A Salesforce organization is implementing a multi-tenant solution where each customer has their own set of custom fields, objects, and workflows.
